A new Network Map layout, a new logo, live meters on the dashboard and a Traffic Map that remembers every country your network has talked to.

### Network Map: redesigned

- **Laid out like a network diagram**: Internet and the firewall on the left, one card per network in the middle, and each network's devices to its right. The cards have room to breathe, and nothing is squeezed into one long column any more.
- **Connectors** run from the firewall to every network (curved) and from each network to its devices. When a link carries traffic a dotted **"string"** runs along it: download dots towards the devices, upload dots back, faster when there is more traffic. Idle links stay a plain line.
- **Device chips**: name with its live dot, IP and vendor, and live download/upload on the right.
- The firewall card shows the total traffic.
- On narrower screens the networks stack under the firewall, each with its devices underneath.
- Light on the CPU: each connector is its own small layer, so a moving link repaints only itself.

### New logo

A "U" holding a sensing node with a signal wave: Uni + Sense. It replaces the old shield mark in the sidebar, on the sign-in page and as the browser icon.

### Dashboard: live meters

- **Memory, Disk, Firewall States, Swap and Mbuf** are no longer half-circle gauges. Each widget shows:
  - the value in large type, with the detail under it;
  - a **live graph of the last minutes**, like the CPU graph, auto-scaled so small changes are visible, with a hover read-out;
  - a slim capacity bar and a legend (e.g. Used / ARC / Free).
  
  Memory refreshes every 5 seconds and Firewall States every 10. The graph's history survives a page reload.
- **Thermal Sensors**: pill-shaped bars in the theme's ok / warning / critical colours, without the axis lines.
- **DHCP leases** (Dnsmasq): the usage reads as text over a slim meter instead of text on an 18 px block.

### Traffic Map: all countries

- New **All countries** tab next to *Top 20*: every country your network has talked to, not just the busiest right now. For each one it shows:
  - **Now**: the live rate, if it is active;
  - **Downloaded** and **Uploaded**;
  - **Share** and **Connections**;
  - **Last seen**.
  
  You can sort by any column and search by name. Clicking the *Countries* card opens the list.
- The history is recorded by a new cron job, **UniSense: record Traffic Map history**, once a minute, also while the page is closed:
  - It counts only what moved since the previous read, so nothing is counted twice.
  - It writes to `/var/db/unisense/trafficmap-history.json` at most once a minute.
  - Countries not seen for 90 days are dropped. *Clear history* starts afresh.
  - Connections that start and end within the same minute are not counted.
- Column headings in sentence case, to match the rest of the theme.

### Update

```sh
fetch -o - https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ox1d3x3/unisense/main/install.sh | sh
```

The installer adds the new cron job next to the existing 01:00 database update. Reload the page in your browser (Ctrl+F5) to pick up the new styles and logo.
